name: Ferdinand Schober
biography: has been ranting about games for several years, and has been playing them in lieu of sleep since grade school. He worked in a security testing position on AAA titles with the highest ranked game publisher, followed by an excursion into web-based and casual game development for a major online game portal. He recently joined the Georgia Institute of Technology as a PhD student and security researcher, focusing on entertainment security.
